_comment: Hand-authored. POIs, seasons and permits are content, not data. Entries marked TO WRITE are shown on the site as an explicit gap, never as invented text.
sourcing: The background reading behind this book is a full crawl of the xBhp “The Tourer” board — India's oldest motorcycling forum — made on 5 August 2026: 337 index pages, 3,317 travelogue threads, of which 14 pan-India ride reports were read end to end. It is transcribed in the field research appendix at the back.
plannedVsRidden: TO WRITE — which sections closed, and what was decided instead.

S3.permits: The Northeast is the one leg of this loop with a bureaucratic layer, and the one thing on it that cannot be improvised on the day. Indian citizens need an Inner Line Permit for Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Mizoram and Manipur — around ₹100–200, typically valid 15 days, and now issued online. Foreign nationals need a Protected Area Permit instead; that regime was tightened for Nagaland, Manipur and Mizoram by a notification of December 2024. This was the position in the sources read on 5 August 2026 — check the current rules before you ride.
